fee_discrepancy_between_pricing_page_and: The pricing page (F-01) states the base direct-sales fee as **"10% + $0.50"** per transaction. The help center fees article (F-P01) states **"a 10% flat fee"** with no mention of a $0.50 per-transaction flat component. Both are reported as found in their respective findings. This discrepancy is noted here for transparency; no reconciliation or interpretation was applied per contract rules.
